doc: Chat attachment delivery contract, section 9: file_extraction_error_legacy_format / errorLegacyFormat
intent: The user attached a .doc/.xls/.ppt or Apple iWork file: tell them it cannot be read and what to do (save it in a newer format and attach it again). Error-style functional copy, same register as the sibling errorUnsupported / errorPasswordProtected. Placeholder {fileName}: iOS writes %@, Android writes %1$s, Web writes {fileName}.

copy.en: Can't read {fileName}. Save it as .docx, .xlsx, or .pptx, then attach it again.
copy.zh-Hans: 暂时读不了 {fileName}，请另存为 .docx、.xlsx 或 .pptx 后重新添加。
copy.zh-Hant: 目前無法讀取 {fileName}，請另存為 .docx、.xlsx 或 .pptx 後重新加入。
copy.ja: {fileName} は読み込めません。.docx・.xlsx・.pptx 形式で保存し直してから、もう一度追加してください。
copy.ko: {fileName} 파일은 읽을 수 없어요. .docx, .xlsx 또는 .pptx 형식으로 다시 저장한 뒤 첨부해 주세요.
